findings.recommendation: Add unit tests that load a TOML file using `listen` and one using `bind_address` through `config::load`, and that serialize an `OrderResponse` and assert the JSON key is `customer_id` (src/api.rs:10-11). Both migration paths are today only verified by a manual staging run (tasks 1.1 and 1.2), so a later edit dropping the `alias` or the `rename` would silently break existing config files or partners' integrations with nothing failing.
findings.title: No automated test pins the `listen` alias and the `customer_id` JSON name

findings.recommendation: `orders` is a library crate (src/lib.rs exposes `pub mod api; pub mod config;`) and the public fields `Config::listen` and `OrderResponse::customer_id` (src/api.rs:11, now `buyer_id`) are renamed in one step, so any Rust code reading `config.listen` or building `OrderResponse { customer_id, .. }` stops compiling, with no BREAKING item in the release note. No such consumer is visible in this repository; if one exists, mark the rename BREAKING in the release note or keep a deprecated accessor for a release.
findings.title: Public Rust fields renamed without deprecation for crate consumers
